instructions: Tools for the Unity project open in the Unity Editor, provided by the GameRebellion SDK. Call unity_status first to see the project's SDK version, settings and last compile. Use unity_get_sdk_reference for exact GameRebellion SDK signatures instead of guessing them. After editing C# scripts, call unity_compile and fix every error it reports before moving on. Unity may be reloading scripts for a few seconds after a compile; the tools wait for it.

tools.name: unity_status
tools.title: Unity project status
tools.description: Where this Unity project stands with GameRebellion: Unity and SDK versions, the settings asset and its environment, whether automatic purchase tracking is on, the signed-in developer and connected game, whether Unity is compiling or in play mode, and the last compile result.

tools.name: unity_get_sdk_reference
tools.title: GameRebellion SDK reference
tools.description: The public API of the GameRebellion SDK installed in this project, read from the assembly itself: every GameRebellion.* method with its parameters, the SDK's enums, and every Gr*Event model with its fields and types. Use it for exact signatures; it marks calls that shouldn't be used.

tools.name: unity_compile
tools.title: Compile scripts
tools.description: Makes Unity pick up script changes on disk and compile them, then returns the errors and warnings. Call it after editing C# files. It waits for the compile, and for the script reload that follows, so it can take tens of seconds. Writes no files.
